verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The phone rings twice in an empty house and then stops.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
dust settles back
onto the cushions
as if nothing called at all

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the cat wakes anyway,
ears turned toward the hallway
where no one is standing

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a shadow crosses the wall
though the window shows
only stillness outside

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the clock ticks louder
in the room that keeps listening
for a second ring

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
phone still in my hand
I check the missed calls
for a name I haven't saved yet

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the tea gone cold again
still I hold the cup
for the warmth that isn't there

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a moth taps the lampshade
patient as if it knows
I'll leave the light on

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the door left unlocked
some habits outlive
the reason we made them

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
morning frost on the window
I trace the shape of a bird
before it flies off my finger

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the calendar page
I keep meaning to turn
still shows last month's moon

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the kettle clicks off
I pour for two
out of old memory

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
an empty coat hook
still holds the shape
of shoulders it misses

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the mirror fogs
before I can decide
whose face I was expecting

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the porch light left on
for someone who now
finds his own way in the dark

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I fold the letter back
into its envelope
still addressed to who I was
